limitations: Coverage is partial: 29 files captured out of 159 eligible and 169 discovered. The 29 explicitly budget-skipped paths include server resources, flexible-server customizations and src/Models extensions; no behavior is inferred from those paths.

The supplied legacy types are concrete non-generated declarations with explicit deprecation or discoverability attributes. They are assessed as retained API contracts, not separately counted once for every routine accessor, Bicep property registration, constructor or enum member.

Generated counterparts, previous releases, generator internals and deployment tests are absent. Obsolete messages identify suggested alternatives but do not prove historical compatibility or that migration is behavior-preserving.
PostgreSqlSecurityAlertPolicyName is hidden with EditorBrowsable(Never) but is not Obsolete; that attribute does not make the enum internal.

The default-create model declares AdministratorLoginPassword as an output without isSecure, and derived source identifiers and restore time are also outputs. These are reported as written, not assumed to be intended input behavior or secure handling.

DataMember annotations are visible on the TLS and server-version enums, but their actual serialization consumer is not supplied. No runtime codec behavior or client-side cryptography is inferred from those annotations or encryption-related names.
Generator-addressable judgments concern plausible generation of retained API contracts and annotations, not measured reductions or proof of a current emitter feature.

Coverage is partial: 29 captured files out of 159 eligible files, with 30 paths explicitly skipped under the review budget; this response makes no claim about customizations outside the supplied evidence.

Many Custom-path declarations resemble mechanically generated provisioning boilerplate despite being labeled handwritten-marker. The supplied paths and attributes support legacy API retention but do not independently establish authorship history, prior generated output, or runtime use.

The obsolete PostgreSqlInfrastructureEncryption enum's member descriptions appear counterintuitive relative to the member names in the supplied source; no service behavior or correction can be established from the supplied lines alone.
